name: qkd_pv16_vport_b1
purpose: Q-ATTN-RATE 2026-10-16: PV16 V port of the KV die (16 per die, ONE master). Replaces the 8-sector double-buffered transposer: with the VMAP=1 V placement each w16 port reads only groups {lane,0}/{lane,1}, every PC streams in the controller's v_consumer_order; the port is a static 2:1 quad select with input + output pin registers and tag checks. Pin-bound (3,276 pins, ~1,230 um2 of cells): 86.4 x 172.8 is the smallest outline at ~6 pins/um per face.

pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every port at the module boundary: every input (pr_*/in0_*/in1_*/rst_n) lands on a flop, every output (vq0_*/vq1_*/out_*/fault) is a flop; cfg_age (static boot-age word) lands on its pin register cfg_q

structural_change: KV-BOOTAGE 10-19 (coordinator decision, lanes/KVR-DERIVE.md re-harden spec): boot-programmable static-schedule ages. qkd_pv16_vport_b = r6 with DQ / RT taken from cfg_age = {DQ, RT} (sealed die cfg, pre-boot image target 10; no handshake): request wait line DQ<=15 deep, slot/sel line DQ+RT+1<=47 deep, the word selects the tap (die-derived RT 16-17 vs the r6 hard 8). +16 pins (cfg_age, S face). Same outline 86.4 x 172.8. Edge-for-edge = r6 #(DQ d, RT r) (lockstep bench, results/rtl/kv_bootage_1019). r6 (Q-VMWB 10-16, closure-first): params DQ 0 / RT 8 only (slot = request + DQ + RT + 1; RL = 4 + W + DQ + RT, W = WP + O is die relays, measured W 59 -> RL 71); the word's epoch travels with it (in{g}_epoch from landing rsp_epoch -> out_epoch -> pair in_epoch check). +48 pins (16 epoch per side, W/E/N). Same outline 86.4 x 172.8, 3-track pins, HB1 out pad, rst_n pin capture. 0 production cycles in the tile.

benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_pv16_vport_b #(.MUT(0), .DQ(15), .RT(31)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/kv_bootage_20261019/qkd_pv16_vport_b.sv && echo lint-ok
